cause: render_grounded_text received generate_lifetimes(...).context_ids and used those verifier-generated pair identities to choose the shape word.
why_invalid: context_ids are not rendered pixels and were not available to a deployed text source; the text stream therefore carried privileged verifier information.
repair: render_grounded_text now accepts pixels only and derives coarse color, brightness, position, and orientation descriptors from the visible mask.
claim_boundary: No raw-byte grounded-text capability is currently promoted. A fresh pixel-only population must be run from the repaired boundary.
